records.source: Where a finished run's measurements are also stored. sqlite keeps only measurements.db. duckdb copies every table into a DuckDB file and parquet into a folder of Parquet files, both for very large screens; postgres copies them into a PostgreSQL database that several users can write at once. spacr_store writes each object table and its crops as the spaCR store in the measurements folder, one Parquet part and one Zarr crop store per well, which spacr.store.open reads. measurements.db stays the working copy every later step reads. Needs pip install spacr[databases]. Default sqlite.
records.translation: 已完成运行的测量结果的额外存储位置。sqlite 仅保留 measurements.db。duckdb 将每张表复制到一个 DuckDB 文件，parquet 则复制到包含 Parquet 文件的文件夹，两者均面向超大规模筛选；postgres 将其复制到可供多用户同时写入的 PostgreSQL 数据库。spacr_store 将每张对象表及其裁剪图作为 spaCR 存储写入 measurements 文件夹，每个孔一个 Parquet 部分和一个 Zarr 裁剪图存储，由 spacr.store.open 读取。measurements.db 仍是所有后续步骤读取的工作副本。需要执行 pip install spacr[databases] 命令。默认值：sqlite。

review_kind: Claude AI translation and review (Claude Opus 5.5). No human or native-speaker signoff.
